text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival 
has arrived. The central plaza is packed 
with even more people than usual—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, looks like you're having fun too.
choice_data_list: Why are you in casual clothes?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Fufun, got you curious?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Actually, since it's the Spring Fan 
Thanksgiving, I was planning on 
participating in a sports-related event, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A friend on the committee begged me with 
tears in her eyes, saying, "Please 
participate in the Miss Tracen Contest!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But you know, becoming the number one in 
Mistres is super difficult.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
They don't just judge your pre-race 
speech, you know—they're checking out your 
everyday fashion sense, too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, because difficulty aside, this 
contest is simply made for me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Waah, Scarlet-chan, you're entering too? 
Miss Training!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: C-Curren!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I seeee~... Then Curren might end up 
losing, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Because Curren wouldn't stand a 
chance. Not if the opponent is 
Scarlet-chan."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"No. Maybe I've been in last place from 
the very beginning."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I mistook "clothes you normally 
wear" for your school uniform. Always.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Curren's such a dummy. No matter 
how much I wanted to win the Grand Prix, 
this is no good at all, is it...? *sniff*

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*, you're so kind.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Somehow, Curren's heart feels 
all warm and fuzzy now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
This might be coming out of nowhere, 
but... Can I ask just one more favor of 
you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I want you to come cheer at Curren's Miss 
Tre. ...Because I feel like I can do my 
best if you're there.

She pleaded with teary, moist eyes. ...I 
have to be of use to her. Such feelings 
threatened to sprout inside me... from 
those eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thanks! See ya then♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...What are you grinning like an idiot 
for?! You stupid Trainer!
choice_data_list:
I'm not being all lovey-dovey or 
anything...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I did do it-!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Honestly! You're *my* trainer, aren't 
you?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All you gotta do is watch me become number 
one! Even as Miss Treve!!

"And mysteriously fired up, Daiwa Scarlet 
entered the Miss Tracen Contest—"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Claiming the Grand Prix title is— Curren 
Chan!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?
choice_data_list: I think you were number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, hate it means I hate it! Ugh, 
second place, of all things...?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haa... Why am I losing, seriously...

Afterward, Daiwa Scarlet remained down in 
the dumps for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Claiming the Grand Prix title is— Daiwa 
Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Thank you for cheering me on, 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you from 
now on too♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Fufun! How's that? Behold my charm!
choice_data_list: As expected of the number one Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Exactly! I am the number one 
Umamusume at this academy!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...So with me right here, you're totally 
not allowed to look at any other girls!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I wonder about that~?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, man, I'm so exhausted. I want to eat 
something sweet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. Treat me to some cake over 
there."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Right, it shouldn't matter anyway.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...The number one Umamusume at the 
academy is asking you, you know. Couldn't 
you just listen to me without arguing?"

And so, I treated Daiwa Scarlet to a slice 
of cake as her reward.
